about.p1: I'm Andri Saputra, a Front-End Developer with the ability to build web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, and React. I have recently completed a bootcamp and am actively seeking opportunities in the tech industry.
about.p2: My journey into Web Development started from curiosity about how websites work and are built, which led me to learn and create them myself. As a career switcher, I bring a different perspective: attention to detail from administrative experience, cross-team coordination from field experience, and a detail-oriented mindset directly relevant to development team collaboration.
about.p3: A diverse background is not a barrier, but an advantage that shapes the way I think, communicate, and collaborate within a team.
about.p4: I believe that a good developer not only writes code, but understands user needs and the business context behind a product — and that is what I want to prove.
